description: April 25 birthday meaning: Taurus decan 1, birthday number 7, Life Path by year, Chinese zodiac note and famous birthdays.
answer: In Western astrology, an April 25 birthday falls in Taurus, in the first decan, with Venus as the sign's ruler and Venus as the decan's. In numerology the day gives birthday number 7. The Life Path also uses the birth year. Taurus is fixed and earth.

sections.heading: The April 25 birthday in astrology
paragraphs: April 25 brings the inward 7 into early Taurus, the Sun about five degrees in. Venus, ruling the sign and this first decan, adds a love of beauty, while the 7 asks quiet questions. The reading is often a contemplative aesthete: a person who thinks best in nature, in music or in unhurried silence.

Astronomically, April 25 puts the Sun near 5° Taurus in most years, inside the first ten-degree slice of the sign, which tradition links with Venus. With Venus as both ruler and sub-ruler, the first decan of Taurus is traditionally seen as the sign at its most sensuous and steady. Birthdays from about April 20 to April 30 land here. The emphasis is on comfort that has been earned: texture, taste, music and the slow pleasure of things done well. This doubled Venus tone is often linked with loyalty and a calm, grounding presence that friends lean on. It can also make change feel like an imposition rather than an invitation. Those born in this decan tend to flourish when they treat flexibility as another form of care, not a threat to it.

sections.heading: Birthday number and Life Path for April 25
paragraphs: Born on the 25th, your compound 2 + 5 reduces to 7. The 2's intuition and the 5's curiosity come together in the 7's reflective, analytical temperament. People born on the 25th are frequently described as perceptive, observant and drawn to understanding how things and people really work. They may test ideas through experience before trusting them. In its secondary role, the 25 is traditionally linked with a strong inner voice and a need for quiet time to process what they have gathered. Their insight often becomes valuable to others once they decide to share it.

Add the birth year and the picture shifts again: an April 25 birthday gives Life Path 3 for 1990, 4 for 2000, 5 for 2010 and 6 for 2020. Some birth years on this date reach the master numbers 22 and 33. Read the birthday number as a secondary note beside that main theme.

sections.heading: Season, Chinese zodiac and famous April 25 birthdays
paragraphs: April birthdays arrive in full northern spring, with lengthening days and fast growth; in the southern hemisphere the month belongs to mid-autumn and harvest. Aries carries most of April, handing over to Taurus around April 19 or 20. As month 4, April brings numerology's number of structure, steadiness and hard work, a grounding counterweight to the quick fire of the month's early birthdays. April 25 is the 115th day of the year (116th in a leap year). Counting forward, the next sign change, into Gemini, is usually complete within 26 days, by May 21.

By April 25 the Chinese new year is well under way, which means the animal and element are those of the calendar birth year. Among the best-known people with an April 25 birthday are Al Pacino (1940), Guglielmo Marconi (1874) and Johan Cruyff (1947).

faq.question: What zodiac sign is April 25?
faq.answer: April 25 is Taurus in every year from 1930 to 2030, wherever you were born. It falls in the first decan of Taurus, which tradition links with Venus.

faq.question: What is the Life Path number for someone born on April 25?
faq.answer: It depends on the birth year. On April 25 the Life Path is 9 in 1960, 1 in 1970, 2 in 1980, 3 in 1990, 4 in 2000, 5 in 2010 and 6 in 2020. The birthday number, from the day alone, is 7 for everyone born on the 25th.

faq.question: What Chinese zodiac sign is someone born on April 25?
faq.answer: For the Chinese zodiac, Lunar New Year has always passed by April 25, so the animal is simply the one for the birth year.

faq.question: Which famous people were born on April 25?
faq.answer: Well-known people born on April 25 include Al Pacino (1940), Guglielmo Marconi (1874) and Johan Cruyff (1947). The list comes from Wikidata and favours people with the most Wikipedia articles.
